Claude_Opus_5._note: First run hit a transient 529 'Overloaded' from Anthropic's API - not a config problem, just retry. Anthropic's Messages API has no logprobs/top_logprobs parameter at all (confirmed against the full API reference, not provider-specific to litellm), so this uses the n-sample fallback path (logprobs=false) instead - pass --nsample=N to control how many independent draws are taken. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. max_tokens is required by Anthropic's API (no default) and left generous since Opus 5 has thinking on by default and thinking output shares the max_tokens budget with the final answer; thinking is left at its default (adaptive) rather than disabled, since disabling it on Opus 5 can leak literal <thinking> tags into the visible answer text, which would break the exact-string-match parsing this pipeline relies on.
